text: Our finance bot polls GET /v1/invoices every night. Invoice INV-88213 for Northwind Data, issued 2025-03-04T09:12Z, shows amount $1,250.00 but the PDF link expires after 24 hours. Can we get a stable signed URL or should we re-fetch daily? Not blocking.

Retry idempotency key 8e12c returns 200, yet invoice INV-88499 remains unpaid. Can you confirm whether this is a webhook handling bug or an invoice sync delay?

Subscription sub_771 is set to renew on 2025-08-02T00:00Z for $12,000.00. Our procurement policy requires invoice before payment, and GET /v1/invoices returns only next cycle preview. Can you issue the renewal invoice now with PO LK-2214?

PATCH /v1/me/password returns 500 internal_error for users who authenticated with Google SSO at 2025-03-18T14:22Z. They see password reset unavailable, but direct password login still works. Is the reset endpoint incompatible with SSO-linked identities?

Connector shopify_shop_77 has not advanced since 2025-07-08T11:43Z; GET /v1/connectors/shopify_shop_77 returns state stalled with last_error cursor_out_of_range. We see 316 missing orders between 2025-07-08 and 2025-07-09. Please force replay from cursor order_882314.

GET /v1/dashboards returns 200 with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 but no Retry-After header, and docs say 429 includes it. We hit 429 at 2025-04-22T17:03:10Z for tenant orbit_analytics. Can you confirm whether missing header is expected?

After our role sync script ran on 2025-10-01, POST /v1/workspaces/32/members returned 201 for 18 users but GET /v1/subscriptions shows 76 active seats instead of 58. This may be overcounting seats and will affect the next invoice. Is the member upsert endpoint double-counting deactivated users?

Workspace ws_881 owner left Arclight Bio; PATCH /v1/workspaces/ws_881/owner returns 403 owner_required. We have admin role but cannot transfer before payroll export. Can you change owner to k.shah?

PATCH /v1/me returned 200 with new email devops@parcelgrid.io at 2025-06-02T10:31Z, but verification mail never arrived. We resent twice with resend=true and checked /v1/me shows email_verified false. Can you check mail delivery logs?

Finance asks whether Starter's 3 dashboards can be pooled across workspaces for Driftwood Games, 18 users. If not, what is Team per-seat monthly with annual commit? No purchase decision until Q3.
